message.content: Evaluator-Driven Iteration (E-DI) is a delegation discipline for iterating work under a fixed quality standard: you can delegate the doing, but never responsibility for the standard. Its loop has three roles—the Maker produces and revises the work, the Evaluator judges it against the fixed standard, and the Orchestrator routes bounds and authors script evaluators—and it exits only through one of three named conditions: accepted, needs_owner, or rejected.
